title: ChampionKV: Head-Wise Adaptive Budget Allocation for KV Cache Compression
abstract: arXiv:2610.18026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Some observation-window-based KV cache compressors use prompt attention to identify important tokens but allocate uniform or predefined budgets across heads, overlooking input-dependent differences in budget demand. We propose ChampionKV, an input-adaptive head-wise budget allocator for long-context KV cache compression. It uses the maximum aggregated observation-window attention score as a lightweight empirical proxy for attention concentration, assigning larger budgets to heads with dispersed attention and smaller budgets to concentrated heads. An abnormal-head mask and a floor-budget mechanism improve robustness under weak attention responses. ChampionKV plugs into compressors such as SnapKV and PyramidKV without changing their token-selection procedures. On LongBench and RULER, both Champion variants consistently improve over their SnapKV and PyramidKV base compressors; the improvements are largest and statistically significant on

translated_title: ChampionKV：面向KV缓存压缩的逐头自适应预算分配
translated_abstract: 一些基于观察窗口的KV缓存压缩器使用提示词注意力来识别重要token，但在各注意力头之间采用统一或预定义的预算分配，忽略了预算需求随输入而异的差异。我们提出ChampionKV，一种面向长上下文KV缓存压缩的输入自适应逐头预算分配器。它使用最大聚合观察窗口注意力分数作为注意力集中度的轻量级经验代理，为注意力分散的头分配更大的预算，为注意力集中的头分配更小的预算。异常头掩码和底限预算机制提升了弱注意力响应下的鲁棒性。ChampionKV可即插即用于SnapKV和PyramidKV等压缩器，无需改变其token选择流程。在LongBench和RULER基准上，两个Champion变体均持续优于其SnapKV和PyramidKV基础压缩器；改进在……上最为显著且具有统计显著性。
tldr: ChampionKV利用观察窗口注意力分数作为注意力集中度的轻量级代理，自适应地为不同注意力头分配KV缓存压缩预算（注意力分散的头获得更大预算），可即插即用于SnapKV和PyramidKV等压缩器并持续提升其性能。
en_tdlr: ChampionKV adaptively allocates KV cache compression budgets across attention heads using the maximum aggregated observation-window attention score as a lightweight proxy for attention concentration, assigning larger budgets to heads with dispersed attention, and consistently improves plug-in compressors like SnapKV and PyramidKV without altering their token-selection procedures.
